a.text: On what will you shine your light? On what can you shine your light?
To do your utmost. That is the glory that all knights should seek.
Glory. Glory did not betray Kazimierz. It is the people that abandoned glory.
That does not mean glory is meaningless.
The word glory itself is far too intangible, Margaret. Wearing it on one's sleeve is foolish.
That is why knights must prove themselves by their deeds alone.
Suppose the cause to which you've dedicated your life turns to sneer at all that you are... Do your deeds still hold meaning?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Ngh...!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Uncle!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: How many times I have told you? Never speak to your opponent in combat.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Then why won't you use your Arts?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I should ask you myself. Your Arts have improved. You must have realized the truth, then?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: About that... yes.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: However...! Uncle Młynar, right now, I would prefer it if you—

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Say no more.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You sent my sword flying. That means you've won, Margaret.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Even though... you never used your Arts at all?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: It was a match, nothing more, nothing less. All other factors are mere excuses. When have I ever taught you to be so indecisive?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If you've come to understand the price your grandfather paid for your naivety, then you must understand the meaning of your return.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Margaret, you are trampling my father's will.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: For us to become cowards?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness.'

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Right. Fear neither hardship nor darkness... You won the battle. You won the chance to continue your mistakes.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Do remember to say your prayers, and pray that your stubbornness won't drag too many souls into its wake.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Uncle...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Do you still believe those times are forever behind us?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Margaret, how dare you ask me this question?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I have a telephone meeting later. Everyone is busy with the Major. As for your little charade... Try not to do anything to distract me from my responsibilities.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Face reality. See how others must live. See their needs. And stop imposing your fantasies on them for your own glory.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You find yourself disappointed, sooner or later.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But what if I don't end up like you?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Like me...? You?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Looks like those Sarkaz friends of yours took excellent care of you during your exile.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret, are you okay...?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes... I'm fine.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Okay, Maria. Stop squeezing her like that. Her arms must be going numb.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh! S-Sorry... Does it hurt?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: *Sigh*. I never imagined I would find you two dueling today—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Młynar hits hard, doesn't he?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: How has he been the past few years?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Normal. He's been living a pretty normal, routine life. He heads out early for work and comes home late, always busy with meetings or dealing with difficult clients, and, once in a while, he gets into debates on account of the 'Nearl' name.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But I'm sure this 'normal' feels enough like a punishment for him.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I mean, he used to be so... Uh, never mind! Let's talk about something else!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Look at how you frown. You won, but it doesn't feel like it, does it? Seems that stubbornness runs in the family.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: At least Uncle Młynar's agreed to let Margaret compete in the Major, right?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: If she takes the crown again, I'm sure that'll be the end of his complaints.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: After, it's all for—
For family. For myself. For... a knight's glory.
To tell the truth, I know the bounty of the land of the knights today is a far cry from the glory of the past.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria? Why so quiet all of a sudden?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Are you hungry?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: A-Auntie!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's give Margaret some time to rest.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Hello?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: My apologies. I just got home, and I had some family matters to deal with... Not a problem. The documents have been annotated.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Sponsoring the Major...? Me? No, please, stop pulling my leg. You know I'm not suited to something like that...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Right... Of course. It's work. I shouldn't be trying to bargain. My apologies.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Yes, of course. I will be there right away.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The window's open, Toland.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You're getting rusty. I could sense your presence.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: But, please, come in through the front door next time.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Okay... Doesn't look like you're hurt.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: He held back.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Yeah... He didn't use his Arts after all.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: And actually, it's been a long time since he had that look on his face...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Alright! Get up.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: So what's your plan now? You need to report to the Knights Association, don't you?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: There is a complicated process, but it's not time yet.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret... We barged into that unfinished match... Is it really going to be alright?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright? You're looking at an exiled Infected, Maria. She smashed through the arena walls and waltzed onto the field, remember?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: With all that she has done, what's interrupting a match or two?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: R-Right... You have a point...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Trouble is an old friend. Be it then or now, so long as Kazimierz remains as it is, we will face all manner of obstacle in our path.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So are you going to compete in the Major, Margaret?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Is that... something that you absolutely have to do?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: It's just... you finally got to come home... I don't think the Association would make things difficult for Uncle and the family...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But if the Chamber of Commerce have their eyes on you again like they did a few years ago, then we—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria has a point, Margaret.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It doesn't matter how the Knights Association deals with this, or what the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's decision is. To the masses and the knights, you are still the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I have to admit... I don't get it either. I don't understand why you insist on competing again... I don't understand what you're thinking.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But I'm sure you have it figured out. Stubbornness may run in the family, but that's not the same thing as recklessness.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: This is just the beginning...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Whether I take the crown or not... it's just a beginning.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, Auntie Zofia. If all we do is cower on the sidelines and look on at society with indifference, if we only comfort ourselves, insisting that nothing can be done—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: —then when will we truly regain our glory?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are the knights of Kazimierz destined to wallow forever in times long past?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: So you want to...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Shining light on the tragedies of the world is not a permanent commitment to dispelling the darkness.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Sometimes... Sometimes, it's just to illuminate the path forward, to help those who are lost see things from a new perspective.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Even in today's Kazimierz, there is still meaning to keeping our faith.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright... Sounds like you've made up your mind.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But you put on such a show as soon as you got back to Kazimierz. If there's a chance... Margaret.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't forget you're home. You have family and memories here. You have Maria... and me.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: At the very least, give Maria some time to fawn on you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: A-Auntie! What are you saying?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: She's been working really hard lately, you know?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-I haven't...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes, I know. I'm proud of you, Maria. You've really... really grown up.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria Nearl, you will be an excellent knight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... right.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: About that... Margaret. If you're thinking of joining the Major, you probably won't have time to rack up the points you need, right?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It will be difficult, but not impossible.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Right... Just like the Candle Knight who's been popular the past few years. I understand it didn't even take her a month to earn enough points.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That may be the case, but the Candle Knight racked up her points early in the preliminaries. Even if Margaret gains the Knights Association's approval right away, we'd still be cutting it close.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What's your plan?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The competition's rules have changed, but the basics are still the same. So long as I scrape together a win in the melees, I should still stand a chance.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But... that's too risky! I drew a lot of attention when I stepped into the ring. If you take to the arena yourself, you're bound to attract even greater opponents...!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Right, and we can't say for sure that the corporations won't pull their dirty tricks on you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Anyway, we need to come up with a plan as soon...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I have an idea.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Independent knights... like me and Margaret... aren't part of a knightclub, so we compete as part of a 'knight family,' right?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's true... You used the Nearl family coat of arms during your matches.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: And, if I remember correctly, it's not just knights of the same knightclub who are allowed to transfer their points, right? Those from the same knight family are allowed to do the same?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Maria?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No, I can't accept that.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, those points are proof of your gallantry as a knight. I can't—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —I don't care!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I chose to become a knight because I wanted our home to be ours.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: The Nearl family's ancestors... Grandfather... Father... and you. I didn't want to lose all that. I wanted to protect the Nearls' glory.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But... But then I realized... I was too naive about all this.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: If we followed them into the Major, if we became their knights just to uphold our knightly name... then... we wouldn't have changed anything.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...I don't actually want to become a knight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Knights can't change the knighthood, Margaret.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: If there is something only you can do, I beg you to do it.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I just want this home to still be our home...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I understand, but I still need some time to think.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright now... Don't be so gloomy. We've got lots of ways to go about this.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Why don't we go to Old Marcin's bar for a drink later? It's been such a long time. I'm sure he wants to talk to you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What about Uncle...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You should try not to bother him. I'll check up on him.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: There's one thing, Margaret.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: There are a lot more Infected in the city than before, and the Armorless Union is also much more active.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Be careful.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Report.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: The Radiant Knight and Młynar Nearl just fought each other in a duel.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: I read their lips. Neither looked very happy.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: *Sigh*... I seriously hope she'll just stay home and spend some time with her family. They haven't seen each other in so long.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Please don't get yourself mixed up in anything you shouldn't, Radiant Knight. I don't want any more trouble to deal with.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Uh, Platinum, so what should we do...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Keep an eye on her.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: If she tries anything, let me know right away.

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What are the others up to? Mission-wise?

steps.name: Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Uh... Per the rules...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'm not allowed to know.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Whatever. It's either something about the Infected or the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: As long as we don't have to lift a finger, it's all fine by me.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Młynar...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Młynar!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Do you need something?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Are you... okay?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret might've stopped herself in that last duel, but you weren't wearing your helmet...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You needn't worry about me.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: She caught you by surprise... didn't she?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: She caught all of us by surprise. After all... she's become far stronger than any of us could've imagined.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Is that all you have to say...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'm worried about you, Młynar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I've fallen so far that it falls on you to worry about me.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Right. I'm sure even you have realized.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: It's just a sprain, nothing more... Her swordsmanship has come a long way, but she's not yet at the point where I can't handle her.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: But... hmm.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You're wondering what made Margaret like this?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Of course, there are her Sarkaz friends. They are all... noble souls. Shockingly noble.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It might just be that she's gone through more over these past few years than either of us could imagine.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maybe... you could swallow your pride just a little and talk to either of them?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Confident enough to order me around now, are you? Did coaching Maria give you such a sense of fulfillment?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Before Margaret became the center of attention, you and your brother were heroes to all of us.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I know how you see the rest of us. Marcin does as well, and so do V and Kowal. Though... at the same time... I am just as disappointed in you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's leave it there. Have fun with work.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Looks like someone used to live here...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Right, there are still traces of their lives... but... are they hiding?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: This is... the third settlement we've come across.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: In a glittering city, the Infected always run to cold, cramped corners like these.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It's hard to believe... How could Kazimierz be this heartless...?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Are these the Infected Amiya and the kind old knight talked about?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Right... If even the knights knew about this, then things can't be that simple.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Do you still have any strength left, Nightingale? It's getting late. We can head back for some rest, if you need.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: No, I can hang on for a little longer.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: In that case—

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Ah—What's the noise?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: A wrecking crew... They're tearing down the buildings... and the subterranean structures beneath.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: What if there are still Infected hiding below?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Remember everything you see, Liz.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Perhaps Nearl knows something about this.
The Radiant Knight walks down the hallway in silence.
The portraits of past champions line the hallway like fences on the side of the road, filling her entire path with their glory.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You... Are you... the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: My apologies. Is this place not open yet?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, uh... No... More accurately, it's not open to the public yet, though I am not sure you count as the public...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Right, sorry about this.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Uh... Forgive me, I haven't yet introduced myself.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Please, call me Malkiewicz. I am the spokes—I am the staff member in charge of maintaining the wall of champions.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Forgive me for asking, Radiant Knight, but what are your plans right now?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Radiant Knight, huh? It wasn't until today that I finally regained that title.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: So the Association gave their approval... Congratulations.
Malkiewicz comes back to his senses. The two of them turn their heads forward, to a portrait of the Radiant Knight herself.
Though she stands right next to him—or perhaps precisely because she's right next to him, a strange feeling washes over Malkiewicz.
The stubbornness is finally starting to loosen, and those things that are locked in place will soon be shattered.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You look much more gallant in person.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's been a few years, after all.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I understand that you... have your differences with the Knights Association and many others. Perhaps this isn't something someone the likes of me should say... But...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I still would like to tell you. I say this not in a professional capacity... But... Rather, as a regular enthusiast of the knighthood and a citizen of the Grand Knight Territory...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Please, go on. You needn't be so reserved.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Welcome back to Kazimierz, Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I truly believe this is the beginning of something great.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh? Margaret, where have you been?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I took a walk around the Grand Knight Territory. Where is Uncle Młynar?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: He got summoned to a meeting just as I got home.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Good thinking, taking a look around town since you just got back. What do you think?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Not much seems to have changed.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Really? I kind of remember there have been a bunch of new fast food joints opening up at the mall the last couple years, though.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But it feels a lot emptier in here...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: We had to sell off a lot of the furniture...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle Młynar is working for the corps, and I've been helping out at Master Kowal's workshop too. We don't have any troubles with our day-to-day expenses, actually, though Uncle Młynar doesn't tell me a whole lot...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But Old Marcin told me there are a lot of knight families and merchants who don't look too kindly on the Nearl family these days. Uncle Młynar might be facing a lot more pressure than we know.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So... Do you think we'll ever patch things up with Uncle?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It'll be difficult, but I'm sure we can.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I had a few arguments with him before I left Kazimierz.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It was Auntie Zofia who told me that Uncle Młynar's been depressed about a lot of things, ever since our parents went missing.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But now... I can't bring myself to agree with what she said, not completely. I... I've seen a lot of people, and a lot of things on my journeys, and now... to face Uncle Młynar again...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Remember the story Grandpa used to tell us when we were kids? How, on their very first trip together, Uncle sorted out a lowly noble who hiked up the tax rates and made life hard on the countryside commoners?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I remember. We just couldn't imagine he used to be a brave young man like that.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's not always the magnificent things that change a person's mind, Maria. I've come across many of those cases.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maybe... he's been disillusioned ever since.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: So how does it feel to be a knight now?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Actually... It's not quite how I imagined it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yeah... I know what you mean.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That's why I will compete in the Major. Even if nobody understands me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret... No... You have people in your corner too, right? Really impassioned supporters!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Do I?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Of course! I'm talking about Shining and Nightingale.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I only met them briefly, but when I saw all of you standing on the stage for such a highly anticipated match, I couldn't help but feel I could trust them with my back.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I've been meaning to ask, what have you been through these past few years?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I will tell you soon enough.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It will be a very long story, though, and it doesn't have a happy ending, not like those novels about knights I used to read to you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Well, we're sisters.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We are.

steps.name: Sarkaz Robber
steps.text: Take everything you see and kill everyone! Get the food!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: A knight? What's a Kazimierz knight doing here?! All the people here are dead, and you'll still get in our way?!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: The Radiant Knight...?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: What do knights stand for?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No! Nearl! It's too dangerous to run into the storm. You need somebody else—No, I'll come with you!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...Faust.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I want her shot through the mouth.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: ...The knights never helped us guerillas.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Our leaders waited years, but in the end, help never came. We fought to the last, alone, until we were devoured by Ursus. Not many of us are still around to tell the tale.

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: The Radiant Knight is back in the arena! What amazing spectacle does she have in store for us today? Will we bear witness to a once-in-decades legend?!

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Is she an Infected or a knight?! Will she reign victorious or will her opponent best her?! With all the dreams weighing on her blade, is it still sharp enough for battle?! Keep your eyes peeled!!

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Please welcome—The Radiant Knight—Maaaaargareeeeeeet Neeeeaaaaaaarl—!
After a long journey, the knight finally made it home.
Just as always, the Radiant Knight steps forward.
She is about to face her greatest challenge.
